## Primary professional positioning

Sajad Dehshiri is a software architect, technical product leader, and senior full-stack developer with professional experience since 2006.

His primary work covers:

- Software architecture
- Technical leadership
- Product engineering
- Production-grade web systems
- System reliability, maintainability, security, and performance
- Technical SEO and product growth
- Applied AI, automation, and AI-assisted engineering
- Teaching and technical mentoring

## Professional evidence

- Active in technology and web development since 2006.
- Former CEO, co-founder, and technical lead of VasetKala.
- Experience leading teams of more than 30 people across product and operations.
- Experience designing and developing high-traffic online platforms.
- Maintainer of public open-source projects and Iran-focused datasets.
- M.Sc. in Intelligent Systems and B.Sc. in Computer Science.

## Selected public project

### Iran Administrative Divisions Dataset

Repository: https://github.com/sajaddp/list-of-cities-in-Iran

A comprehensive open-source dataset of Iran's provinces, counties, districts, cities, and rural districts. It provides CSV, JSON, and XLSX outputs and integration guidance for multiple languages and database systems.
